class.name: CSSStyleSheet
class.brief_description: A shared CSS resource imported from a project [code].css[/code] file.
class.description: A [CSSStyleSheet] stores the source text of a project [code].css[/code] file imported by Dockit. The importer registers local [code]@import[/code] files as build dependencies so Godot can reimport the stylesheet when an imported file changes. HTML documents that link to the same imported stylesheet use the shared resource. Changing [member css_text] emits [signal Resource.changed], invalidating the styles of current layouts that use the resource so they can refresh. The changed text remains in memory and does not write back to the source [code].css[/code] file. Edit and reimport the source file to persist changes. [member source_path] records the source path assigned by the importer. It is empty for manually created resources unless set.

members.member: The CSS source text. Changing it emits [signal Resource.changed] so layouts using this resource can refresh.
The original [code].css[/code] source path recorded by the importer. Manually created resources leave it empty unless set.
